name: magic-claude-code-plugin
description: kouui's Claude Code plugins. This repo is only an index: each plugin lives in its own repository.

plugins.name: struct-compact
plugins.description: Replace default compaction with a structured handoff written by haiku from a slimmed transcript; keeps the last 4 text messages.

plugins.name: ste
plugins.description: Rewrite English into ASD-STE100 Simplified Technical English so an AI agent or downstream system cannot misparse it.

plugins.name: zh-plain
plugins.description: Write or rewrite Chinese text so a human or AI agent cannot misread it: documents, skills, prompts, tool descriptions, specs.

plugins.name: usage-hud
plugins.description: A band above the prompt showing model, directory, git branch, context fill and plan-window usage with reset countdowns. No runtime dependency.

plugins.name: readonly-agents
plugins.description: Two subagents: reader (read and search, plus plain read-only git queries) and verifier (runs things in its own git worktree).

plugins.name: coding
plugins.description: Task preparation, GitHub PR and gh CLI skills, and four review/brainstorm subagents (architecture, plan, code, brainstorm).
